Class Projectile

java.lang.Object
logic.tower.Projectile
public final class Projectile extends Object
Projectile fired by towers toward a specific enemy target.

    • Projectile

      public Projectile(double x, double y, double speed, int damage, Enemy target, String spriteName)
      Creates a projectile.
      Parameters:
      x - initial x position
      y - initial y position
      speed - movement speed per update
      damage - damage applied on hit
      target - target enemy
      spriteName - projectile sprite resource path; defaults when blank/null
